purpose: Verified 25-record batch 112 from the clean 331-record reference-dependent queue. Batch size was intentionally reduced below the 50-record ceiling. spells/otilukes-greater-dispelling-scree.name: Otiluke's Greater Dispelling Screen
spells/otilukes-greater-dispelling-scree.effectSummary: Creates the same opaque, immobile violet screen as Otiluke's dispelling screen: creatures and unattended objects crossing it are subjected to targeted dispel checks, attended gear is unaffected, unattended magic items can have their magic suppressed for 1d4 rounds, and spell effects not operating on creatures or objects cannot pass through. Disintegrate or a successful dispel magic removes the screen and antimagic suppresses it. This greater version raises the maximum caster-level bonus on its dispel checks from +10 to +20.

spells/resist-elements-3789.name: Resist Elements
spells/resist-elements-3789.effectSummary: Protects the touched creature against one chosen energy type as the source-era endure elements spell, but absorbs the first 12 points of damage of that type. It does not stack with endure elements or protection from elements; if protection from elements is also active, that spell absorbs damage first, and if only resist elements and endure elements overlap, resist elements supplies the absorption.

spells/simbuls-spell-matrix-1787.name: Simbul's Spell Matrix
spells/simbuls-spell-matrix-1787.effectSummary: Creates a personal matrix that can store up to four spells of 3rd level or lower. During the four rounds after casting, you can place one eligible spell into it per round; only spells that can be Quickened qualify. Each stored spell deals 1d6 damage to you that cannot be healed while the matrix exists. Stored spells can later be cast once each as free actions and count as quickened spells for the round. A successful dispel removes the matrix and all stored spells, antimagic suppresses it, and death dissipates it. Focus: amber worth at least 500 gp.

spells/undead-bane-weapon-1804.name: Undead Bane Weapon
spells/undead-bane-weapon-1804.effectSummary: For 1 hour per caster level, one weapon gains undead bane in addition to its other properties: against undead its enhancement bonus is +2 higher and it deals +2d6 bonus damage. At caster level 9 or higher a nonmagical weapon also gains +1 enhancement. The spell can instead affect up to fifty same-type arrows, bolts, or bullets, which lose the transmutation after being fired. It has no effect on a weapon already possessing undead bane, counts the weapon as blessed, and makes it glow like a candle.
